meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能通过 Discord 机器人跟你聊天:把 Discord 适配器接入系统,配置机器人令牌后,你可以在 Discord 私聊或服务器频道里和它对话。
howto.when: 在 /setup 流程中要求添加 Discord 频道,或使用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 关联频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Discord 频道
say.note: 开始执行添加 Discord 机器人的步骤。

say.text: 把 Discord 机器人接入我的服务器
say.note: 引导你获取 Bot Token 并邀请机器人。

say.text: 用 /manage-channels 配置 Discord 集成
say.note: 打开频道管理,进入 Discord 添加流程。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude talk to you via a Discord bot: it integrates the Discord adapter and, after you configure the bot token, you can chat with it in DMs or server channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Discord channel during setup, or when using /init-first-agent or /manage-channels to connect a channel.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel for me
say_en.note: Starts the Discord bot integration steps.

say_en.text: Connect the Discord bot to my server
say_en.note: Guides you through getting the Bot Token and inviting the bot.
Opens channel management for Discord integration.
